title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E12 — Suitcase Case
Lamont stumbles upon a suitcase full of what he's sure is stolen money and calls the police to come take it away. Not wanting to take any chances, Fred locks the find up in the safe.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E13 — Return Of The Barracuda
Fred and Donna have reconciled their differences and are once again planning to wed. Fred even gives her an engagement ring to make it official.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E14 — Piano Movers
A great deal on a grand piano finds Lamont and Fred lodged in the apartment of a wealthy eccentric.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E1 — The Light Housekeeper
When Fred Sanford receives a slight injury in a car mishap, Lamont finds himself waiting on his father hand and foot. Fred rejects the idea of having Aunt Ethel help him around the house and settles for Lamont's zany plan to hire a housekeeper.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E6 — Good News, Bad News
An introduction to a friend puts Helen and Louise's friendship on the line -- and George couldn't be happier.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E7 — The Visitors
George and Louise are caught in the line of fire when Florence's battling parents pay the Jefferson household an unexpected and unnerving visit.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E8 — Camp-out, The
George may be over his head when he introduces his young clerk Marcus to 'roughing it.'.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E9 — The Last Leaf
When a superstitious Louise gets a 'sign' that her marriage is doomed, George is forced to make a decision that could change the rest of their lives.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E10 — Louise's New Interest
Is Louise going away on a weekend Indian 'dig' because of her interest in archeology or in the handsome archeologist? And that's exactly what George and Helen want to know.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E11 — Costume Party, The
George's cleaning business may be cleaned up for good when he resorts to playing a dirty trick in order to secure the business of a large costume company.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E12 — Florence Gets Lucky
George must make a painful admission when he discovers he needs Florence far more than he could ever expect.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S1 E12 — Tony Randall, Lena Horne
Tony & Lena want to leave NYC by cab; Tony & Flip are an odd couple of inmates: Lena gets food & philosophy at Charley's Diner.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S1 E15 — Bing Crosby, The Supremes, David Steinberg
Bing teaches golf; The Supremes help Freddie Johnson do holiday shopping; David does monologue and Geraldine's a bunny waitress.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S1 E16 — Steve Lawrence, Zero Mostel
Mostel portrays a painter and a ledge-jumper; Flip defends his singing ability and Charley’s Diner serves Mostel and Lawrence.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S1 E17 — Muhammad Ali, Bobby Darin, Lily Tomlin
The boxing champ makes poetic predictions for his Joe Frazier fight; Tomlin’s a health nut; Flip & Bobby do a vaudeville bit.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S1 E19 — Joe Namath, George Carlin, Abbey Lincoln, Johnny Mathis
Carlin does his Indian Sergeant routine; Abbey dates Freddie Johnson; Flip & Mathis compare dogs and Geraldine works at Namath’s gym.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E14 — Belafonte/Nelson/Poitier
Sidney Poitier and Harry Belafonte discuss their new film, Buck and the Preacher, as well as other topics, interrupted by interludes of song by Novella Nelson.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E15 — Ruby Dee/Ossie Davis
Ruby Dee and Ossie Davis, aided by the music of composer-saxophonist Lucky Thompson, give dramatic readings of the poetry of a writer named Robert Cornell Kaufman.

title: Webster
description:
S3 E16 — That's Rich
Webster learns that you can be rich without having a lot of money after he gets struck with lottery fever.

title: Webster
description:
S3 E17 — TV or Not TV
When George is assigned to children's sports after a popular segment on Webster's hockey team, he worries his career will be damaged.

title: Webster
description:
S3 E18 — Borrowed Time
Rob's dad kidnaps him and Webster tries to rally up support to try and find him.

title: Webster
description:
S3 E20 — A Friend in Need
Jerry dresses up like a clown and takes Webster to the leukemia ward at the children's hospital, where he makes a new friend and realizes how lucky he is to be healthy.

title: Webster
description:
S3 E21 — Almost Home
Webster's Uncle Jack has Webster visit him. Uncle Jack runs a foster home with a woman, but a conflict may force him to quit the home.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S4 E18 — My Guy
A high school nerd out to woo Tia turns to Tamera for help in updating his image, but when his makeover is complete, Tamera realizes she wants to keep him for herself!

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S4 E19 — Double Dutch
When a girl from Tia's old neighborhood challenges her to a double Dutch jump rope contest, Tia becomes obsessed with winning.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S4 E20 — Inherit the Twin
Tia and Tamera wind up in student court, where the two boys who are supposedly defending them wind up dissing them instead.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S4 E21 — Slime Party
Tia and Tamera audition for a game show, where their opponents are famous TV twins Mary-Kate and Ashley Olsen.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S4 E22 — Guardian Angel
The spirit of Ray's late wife returns to help Tamera make a tough decision, and Ray to get on with his life.

title: Moesha
description:
S6 E18 — Saving Private Rita
Moesha saves a suicidal friend, while Dorian pretends to be religious to impress a cute girl.
